params.name: dueAtTime
params.description: Due date of the training assignment in RFC 3339 format. Millisecond precision and timezones are supported.

items.docs: This endpoint supports batch deletion operations. The response does not indicate which specific deletions, if any, have failed. On a successful deletion or partial failure, a 204 No Content status is returned. Rate limit: 10 requests/sec (learn more about rate limits here). To use this endpoint, select **Write Training Assignments** under the Closed Beta category when creating or editing an API token.
